_note: Narration for prob_live_demo.mp4 (60 s). 'at' = second where the line starts. Edit the text freely; voice.py fits each line into its slot.

lines.text: Meet prob. An AI agent tests our lab.
It asks a real question from biophysics: can a proofreading network beat the Hopfield bound?
The lead splits the work. The planner weighs the cost.
The verifier says no, and names the case that failed.
The next claim passes. Exact certificate.
Then a surprise. A result breaks an assumption, and the lab reopens it.
A red team on another model attacks it. It holds.
The agent re-runs a certificate in the browser.
Nudge one rate by 0.1 percent. Fail.
This run took six minutes. Real studies run for hours, round after round.
A human approves. The scribe writes the paper.
Eleven exact violations, among eighty-eight networks.
